+"""Directed residual transport with soft codebook separation."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute the masked directed transport objective from the frozen proposal."""
+    alpha = parameters.get("alpha", 0.5)
+    beta = parameters.get("beta", 1.0)
+    margin = parameters.get("m", 0.1)
+    sigma = parameters.get("sigma", 0.05)
+    tau = parameters.get("tau", 1.0)
+    weight = parameters.get("w", 0.0001)
+
+    # Assignment and residual are source-conditioned; displacement is explicitly
+    # target - source, so exchanging pair endpoints changes the prediction.
+    assignments = torch.softmax(
+        -torch.cdist(source, codebook).pow(2) / tau, dim=-1
+    )
+    centroid = assignments @ codebook
+    residual = source - centroid
+    displacement = target - source
+    prediction = centroid + displacement + alpha * residual
+    transport = (target - prediction).pow(2).sum(dim=-1) / source.shape[-1]
+
+    pair_distances = torch.cdist(codebook, codebook)
+    diagonal = torch.eye(codebook.shape[0], device=codebook.device, dtype=torch.bool)
+    nearest = pair_distances.masked_fill(diagonal, float("inf")).min(dim=-1).values
+    separation = F.softplus((margin - nearest) / sigma)
+    separation = (assignments * separation.unsqueeze(0)).sum(dim=-1) / codebook.shape[0]
+
+    valid = mask.to(dtype=source.dtype)
+    denominator = valid.sum().clamp_min(1.0)
+    per_row = transport + beta * separation
+    return weight * (per_row * valid).sum() / denominator
